title: Oppenheimer's Gita quote originally 'I am time'

tellings.quote: reading that the original translation was not I am death the destroyer of worlds. It was I am time the destroyer of worlds.

plain: The famous line that the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer quoted in 1945 from the Bhagavad Gita, an ancient Hindu scripture, "I am death, the destroyer of worlds," is said to have originally read "I am time, the destroyer of worlds." A guest named Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, tells it as something he read. It would change the sense of one of the best known lines of the atomic age.
